text:
maria g: Heads-up — handbook page /handbook/engineering/oncall.mdx has an embedded SVG that's 404-ing in production (noticed on staging too). Can the owner please take a look? Screenshot: https://screenshot.internal/handbook/oncall-404.png

alex f: Hmm, I saw that. Might be due to an S3 path rename after the asset sweep. Which SVG name?

maria g: It's 'oncall-diagram.svg' referenced as ./assets/oncall-diagram.svg in the MDX. Page URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/engineering/oncall

alex f: I can take it. Will check S3 keys and open a quick PR if it's a bad path.

sam t: FYI, the deploy bot failed once when I tested; the bundler choked on the .svg import. log: `Error: ENOENT`

julia: If it's just a path change, we can swap to the static-assets CDN path: `/cdn/assets/handbook/oncall-diagram.svg`

alex f: digging... quick curl to confirm: `curl -sI https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/oncall-diagram.svg | head -n 1`

docs-bot: Automated scan flagged a broken embed on /handbook/engineering/oncall.mdx (scan-id: 2026-03-17-099).

alex f: found S3 key at s3://redwood-docs-prod/handbook/old/oncall-diagram.svg — looks like the file moved during last week's asset reorg.

alex f: opening PR to update path and add fallback: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5238 : will also add an alt text note. ETA 30m :hourglass:

maria g: Thank you! Can you @eng-platform for a quick deploy once merged? Need the handbook patch live for oncall runbook.

alex f: ping @eng-platform — cc: @julia

eng-platform: Noted. We'll expedite the docs deploy after the PR merges. If you add the `docs:skip` label we won't delay, otherwise standard pipeline.

alex f: PR linked and labeled. Also added a tiny test in CI to validate mdx asset links: `scripts/check-assets.sh`

sam t: Nice — if CI finds anything else, please add owners to the files (/OWNERS).

maria g: Also adding a quick note in the runbook about how to check SVGs: `browser devtools > network` + `curl -I`.

julia: Thanks, folks. Let me know if you want me to mint a redirect in the CDN if the old path still gets traffic.

alex f: Merged, deploy queued. Closing the loop here — thx :thumbsup:
